coverage: ROSTER: the angle names no explicit URLs, so its "named roster" was its source types (craft essays and writing-advice by novelists, editors and game designers). Discovery: a full crawl of the BrightWeavings sitemap (549 URLs) diffed against the 130 URLs the predecessor finder had already read, plus eight lateral WebSearches; the last two consecutive searches surfaced nothing new. 76 new sources fetched RAW by curl with a browser user agent (no summariser, no snippet, no aggregator); 45 substantive, 30 non-substantive (index pages, art pages, video-only pages, student essays, review roundups), 1 blocked (justaword.fr, a Medium-hosted interview returning a 750-byte stub). Per route: site-crawl/bibliography-chasing 58 fetched (36 substantive); lateral search 16 fetched (8 substantive); direct named-venue fetch 2. Reddit was unreachable for raw reads (both the old.reddit HTML and .json endpoints return the login interstitial to curl), so no reader-forum claims were added this round. GAPS: no game designer writing about Kay's prose was found (the only games-adjacent source is an RPGnet thread the predecessor already read), and no stylometric or corpus study of Kay exists that this sweep could locate. The checkpoint file sweep/found-kay-craft.json carries the predecessor's 120 claims plus these 163 new ones (283 claims across 126 sources); this return carries only the 163 new claims and the 76 new sources.
